extName.description: Extension name shown in Chrome and as the Web Store listing title. Kept in English: the brand and the feature name are what users type in the store search.

extDescription.message: Atalhos de teclado para o stem player do Moises.ai — silencie ou isole qualquer faixa com uma só tecla
extDescription.description: Manifest description. Doubles as the Web Store listing summary; max 132 characters.

popupStatusActive.message: Ativo neste player — pressione uma tecla
popupStatusActive.description: Popup status when the active tab is the Moises player.

popupStatusWaiting.description: Popup status when the active tab is not the Moises player; followed by the open-player link.

popupOpenPlayer.description: Link that opens the Moises player in a new tab.

popupHintTyping.message: Os atalhos pausam enquanto você digita em um campo de texto.

popupHintPasteSuffix.description: Input-safety hint, rendered after the Ctrl+V keycaps.

popupMute.description: Action label in the shortcut rows. Kept in English across locales — a standard audio term matching the MUTE/SOLO toast chips.

popupSolo.description: Action label in the shortcut rows. Kept in English across locales.

popupFeedback.description: Footer link to the feedback form.

errTrackNotFound.description: In-page error toast suffix, composed as '<track>: <this>'. The track name comes from the player DOM and is not translated.

errContainerNotFound.description: In-page error toast suffix, composed as '<track>: <this>'.

errButtonNotFound.description: In-page error toast suffix, composed as '<track> <action>: <this>'. The action (mute/solo) stays in English, matching the toast chips.

errNoControls.description: Toast de erro exibido quando o frame do player não expõe controles de faixa reconhecíveis.

errDetectedLabels.description: Precede a lista de rótulos de faixa encontrados no DOM do player, no toast de diagnóstico. Os rótulos vêm do player e não são traduzidos.

feedbackLink.description: Text of the dismissible in-player feedback pill.

feedbackDismiss.description: Tooltip on the ✕ that closes the feedback and review pills.

reviewText.description: Lead-in text of the in-player review prompt, shown after a few successful uses.

reviewCta.description: Link in the review prompt that opens the Chrome Web Store review page.

reportLink.description: Link no toast de diagnóstico que abre o formulário de feedback.

cheatsheetTitle.description: Título do card no player que mostra os atalhos sem abrir o popup.

cheatsheetTryPrefix.description: Texto antes da tecla: "Experimente [V] para silenciar Vocals".

cheatsheetTrySuffix.description: Texto entre a tecla e o nome da faixa.

cheatsheetShowKeys.description: Ação do card que expande a tabela completa.

cheatsheetHideKeys.description: Ação do card que recolhe a tabela.

cheatsheetNativeTitle.description: Cabeçalho dos atalhos nativos do Moises, que a extensão nunca intercepta.

cheatsheetNativePlayPause.description: Rótulo do atalho de barra de espaço do próprio player.
